select id, ho_ten from nhan_vien where p: select id, full_name from employees where department = 'Accounting' order by full_name
select nv.ma_nv, nv.ho_ten, pb.ten_phong: select e.emp_id, e.full_name, d.dept_name, sum(p.salary) as total_salary from employees e inner join departments d on d.id = e.dept_id left join payroll p on p.emp_id = e.emp_id and p.year = 2026 where e.status = 'active' and d.dept_name in ('Accounting', 'Sales') group by e.emp_id, e.full_name, d.dept_name having sum(p.salary) > 100000 order by total_salary desc limit 20;
